script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Laxmi Sandal Merchant ji — main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon. Seedha kaam ki baat karta hoon: aapke account mein pichhle mahine buyers ke inquiries — yaani Business Leads — 60.6% gir gayi hain. Teen saal se aap hamare saath hain, toh yeh trend dekh ke mujhe lagaa ek baar aapse baat karni chahiye.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai, ek cheez samajhna chahta hoon — jab koi buyer aapko call karta hai ya message karta hoon, toh kya aapko lagta hai ki woh sahi product dhundh ke aa raha hai, ya unhe aapka catalog thoda confusing lagta hai? Aur kya kabhi aisa hua ki buyer ne contact kiya aur connect nahi ho paya?
script_parts.value_demo: Yeh isliye pooch raha hoon kyunki data mein ek serious issue dikh raha hai — aapka Phone Not Switched success rate sirf 3.8% hai, matlab 100 mein se sirf 4 buyers aapse actually connect ho pa rahe hain. Saath mein, aapka Catalog Quality Score 55 hai — 60 se neeche hone ki wajah se IndiaMART ka algorithm aapki listings ko buyers ko kam dikhata hai. Yeh dono cheezein milke leads ko rok rahi hain.
script_parts.action: Toh bhai, abhi is call pe ek kaam karte hain — main aapka catalog kholta hoon aur aapke top 2-3 sandal products ki listing check karta hoon. Dekhte hain ki images, price, aur description mein kya missing hai jo CQS score ko 60+ le jaaye. Aap mere saath screen pe guide kar sakte hain ki kaunsa product aapka best seller hai.
script_parts.close: Bhai, aaj ek cheez fix kar lete hain — baaki changes ke liye main aapko ek simple checklist WhatsApp pe bhej dunga. Koi pressure nahi, bas yeh ek step aaj complete kar lein — theek hai?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, Laxmi Sandal Merchant ji — I'm calling from IndiaMART. I'll get straight to the point: your Business Leads dropped by 60.6% last month alone. You've been with us for over 10 years, so seeing this trend made me want to reach out directly.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to understand something — when buyers contact you or call, do you feel they're finding the right products on your profile, or does your catalog seem unclear to them? And has it happened that a buyer tried to reach you but the call didn't connect?
script_parts_en.value_demo: I'm asking because the data shows two serious issues: your Phone Not Switched success rate is only 3.8%, meaning only 4 out of 100 buyers who try to call you are actually getting through. On top of that, your Catalog Quality Score is 55 — below the 60 threshold — which means IndiaMART's algorithm is actively showing your listings to fewer buyers. These two factors together are causing your lead collapse.
script_parts_en.action: So let's do one thing right now on this call — I'll pull up your catalog and we'll look at your top 2-3 sandal product listings together. We'll identify what's missing in the images, pricing, or description that's pulling your CQS below 60. Just tell me which product is your best seller and we'll start there.
script_parts_en.close: Bhai, let's fix just one listing today — I'll send you a simple checklist on WhatsApp for the rest. No pressure, just this one step today — does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
